mapper.sql: report_key, session_key, report_name, note, stage, diagnosis_status, snapshot_json, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_diagnosis_report_v1 (report_key, session_key, report_name, note, stage, diagnosis_status, snapshot_json) VALUES (#{reportKey}, #{sessionKey}, #{reportName}, #{note}, #{stage}, #{diagnosisStatus}, CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS JSON))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM saved_diagnosis_report_v1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
